findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards the receiver and returns a fresh logger
findings.description: `FromContext` ignores its receiver `f` and the `ctx` argument, and returns `NewTestLogger()`. Any entries recorded on `f` (for example `Info` or `Error` calls) are not visible through the returned logger, and the context is not applied. Tests that route logging through `FromContext` and then assert on the original `TestLogger` will see no calls. The real `grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext` derives from the receiver, so the fake's behavior diverges from the real implementation.

findings.title: Test function name still references the old middleware
findings.description: The test now constructs `newMetricsMiddleware(...)`, but its function is still named `TestInstrumentationMiddleware`, which refers to the renamed type. The name no longer matches the code it exercises.

findings.title: New Logger interface method may be unimplemented by other types
findings.description: `Logger` gains a `FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger` method. Any other type in the repository that implements `plugins/log.Logger` and is not shown in this diff will fail to compile until it also gets `FromContext`. I could not check for other implementers without file access.
